overall_notes: This paper focuses on multimodal NLG evaluation for image captioning, visual question answering, and rank classification tasks. The core contribution is developing supervised retrieval methods (MSIER) for in-context example selection to improve MLLM performance. All evaluations used automatic metrics with no human or LLM-as-judge assessments. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of dataset names and addition of the rank classification task.
